text:
marta: Follow-up from canary: observed orphan provisional leases when finalizer RPC timed out and client retried without stable id. want quick alignment on mitigation.

jp: we measured ~0.6% token skew for one tenant.

sai: can you walk the failure path?

marta: edge issues provisional lease, prefix cache returns tokens, finalizer times out in commit phase, client retries -> second lease applied; original stays PROVISIONAL.

oliver: duplicate charges + leftover provisionals. root cause seems lease lifecycle + unreliable dedupe keys.

jp: short-term choices: 1) strong dedupe key on finalizer, 2) postpone provisional until commit (adds latency), 3) TTL + reconcilier that emits explicit correction events.

sai: request_id isn't reliable across SDKs. composite dedupe key (tenant + session + prefix_fp + request_fp) is an option but not perfect.

ingest-bot: canary: meter-finalizer v2 deployed 6m ago.

marta: proposed short-term: keep provisional but add audit_tag and a reconcilier that scans provisionals older than default 5m, checks for finalization, and emits a correction envelope if missing. correction envelope example: {"type":"correction","orig_lease_id":"<uuid>","tenant":"t-123","delta_tokens":"-X","reason":"orphan_provisional_after_5m"}.

jp: policy: if a correction exists, later finalization should be a no-op. add metrics: provisional_count, orphan_count, corrections_emitted, finalizations_after_correction, and per-tenant finalizer_latency_ms histograms. make TTL tenant-configurable.

sai: add synthetic tests that inject delayed finalizations to ensure we don't over-refund.

oliver: long-term: evaluate avoiding provisional leases for idempotent cached-prefix responses. big accounting impact, but worth RFC.

marta: actions: jp -> implement correction envelope + ORPHAN tag (2d), sai -> dashboards + alert if orphan_rate >0.1% (3d), oliver -> perf/sim of composite dedupe key on 7d traffic (1w). i'll open RFC PR and tag folks.
jp: +1
sai: +1
oliver: +1 :thumbsup:
marta: thanks, closing.
